# Frontend vendor assets

These files are intentionally stored locally so the management console works
inside networks without Internet access.

| Library | Version | License | Upstream |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | MIT | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap |
| jQuery | 3.7.1 | MIT | https://github.com/jquery/jquery |
| DataTables | 1.13.8 | MIT | https://github.com/DataTables/DataTablesSrc |
| Chart.js | 4.4.7 | MIT | https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.5.2 | Icons: CC BY 4.0; Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; Code: MIT | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome |

Only the Font Awesome solid WOFF2 font used by this application is bundled.
